allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n181\t\n182\t    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n183\t        allTriangles = &triangles;\n184\t        if (triangles.empty()) return;\n185\t\n186\t {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {\n191\t                minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);\n192\t                minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);\n193\t                minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);\n194\t                maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);\n195\t                maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);\n196\t                maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);\n197\t            }\n198\t        }\n199\t\n200\t        // Collect all indices\n201\t        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());\n202\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); ++i) allIndices[i] = i;\n203\t\n204\t        buildNode(allIndices, minBound, maxBound);\n205\t    }\n206\t\n207\tprivate:\n208\t    void buildNode(const std::vector<size_t>& indices, const Vec3& nodeMin, const Vec3& nodeMax) {\n209\t        minBound = nodeMin;\n210\t        maxBound = nodeMax;\n211\t        halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;\n212\t        center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n213\t\n214\t        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n215\t        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n216\t            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n217\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n218\t            return;\n219\t        }\n220\t\n221\t        // Subdivide into 8 children\n222\t        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n223\t        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n224\t\n225\t        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n226\t            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n227\t\n228\t            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n229\t            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n230\t                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n231\t                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n232\t                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n233\t                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n234\t\n235\t                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n236\t                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n237\t                }\n238\t            }\n239\t        }\n240\t\n241\t        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n242\t        bool canSplit = false;\n243\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n244\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n245\t                canSplit = true;\n246\t                break;\n247\t            }\n248\t        }\n249\t\n250\t        if (!canSplit) {\n251\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n252\t            return;\n253\t        }\n254\t\n255\t        // Build children\n256\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n257\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n258\t                Vec3 childMin = center;\n259\t                Vec3 childMax = center;\n260\t                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n261\t                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n262\t                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n263\t                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n264\t                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n265\t                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n266\t\n267\t                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n268\t                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n269\t                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n270\t            }\n271\t        }\n272\t    }\n273\t\n274\tpublic:\n275\t    // Check if a ray intersects this node's bounding box\n276\t    bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) const {\n277\t        Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n278\t        Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n279\t        Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};\n280\t\n281\t        if (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n282\t        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n283\t        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n284\t\n285\t        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n286\t        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n287\t        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n288\t\n289\t        return true;\n290\t    }\n291\t\n292\t    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n293\t    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n294\t    template<typename Func>\n295\t    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n296\t        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n297\t        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {\n298\t            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {\n299\t                if (func(idx, (*allTriangles)[idx])) return true;\n300\t            }\n301\t            return false;\n302\t        }\n303\t\n304\t        // Otherwise, descend to children\n305\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n306\t            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n307\t                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;\n308\t            }\n309\t        }\n310\t        return false;\n311\t    }\n312\t};\n313\t\n314\t// ============================================================================\n315\t// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n316\t// ============================================================================\n317\t\n318\t// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\n319\tclass IcosphereMesh {\n320\tpublic:\n321\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n322\t\n323\t    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n324\t        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n325\t        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n326\t\n327\t        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n328\t            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n329\t            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n330\t            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n331\t            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n332\t            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n333\t            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n334\t            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n335\t            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n336\t            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n337\t            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n338\t            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n339\t            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n340\t        };\n341\t\n342\t        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n343\t        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n344\t            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n345\t            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n346\t            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n347\t            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n348\t        };\n349\t\n350\t        // Subdivide\n351\t        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n352\t            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n353\t            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n354\t\n355\t            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n356\t                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n357\t                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n358\t                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n359\t\n360\t                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n361\t                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n362\t                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n363\t                vertices.push_back(mid);\n364\t                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n365\t                return idx;\n366\t            };\n367\t\n368\t            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n369\t                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n370\t                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n371\t                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n372\t\n373\t                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n374\t                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n375\t                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n376\t                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n377\t            }\n378\t            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n379\t        }\n380\t\n381\t        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n382\t        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n383\t        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n384\t            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n385\t            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n386\t        }\n387\t    }\n388\t};\n389\t\n390\t// ============================================================================\n391\t// Random Number Generation\n392\t// ============================================================================\n393\t\n394\tclass RandomGenerator {\n395\t    std::mt19937 rng;\n396\t    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\n397\tpublic:\n398\t    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n399\t    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n400\t};\n401\t\n402\t// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n403\tVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n404\t    val_t u = rng.rand();\n405\t    val_t v = rng.rand();\n406\t    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n407\t        u = 1.0f - u;\n408\t        v = 1.0f - v;\n409\t    }\n410\t    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n411\t    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n412\t    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n413\t}\n414\t\n415\t// ============================================================================\n416\t// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n417\t// ============================================================================\n418\t\n419\tval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n420\t                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n421\t    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n422\t    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n423\t    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n424\t    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n425\t\n426\t    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n427\t\n428\t    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n429\t    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n430\t    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n431\t    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432\t\n433\t    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434\t    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435\t    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n436\t\n437\t    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n438\t}\n439\t\n440\t// ============================================================================\n441\t// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n442\t// ============================================================================\n443\t\n444\t// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n445\t// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\n446\tbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n447\t                  const Octree& octree,\n448\t                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n449\t    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n450\t    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n451\t    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n452\t    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n453\t\n454\t    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n455\t        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n456\t\n457\t        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n458\t        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n459\t            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n460\t        }\n461\t        return false;\n462\t    });\n463\t}\n464\t\n465\t// ============================================================================\n466\t// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n467\t// ============================================================================\n468\t\n469\t// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n470\tval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n471\t    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n472\t    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n473\t    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n474\t}\n475\t\n476\t// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n477\tval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n478\t                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n479\t                  const Octree& octree,\n480\t                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481\t    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482\t    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483\t\n484\t    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485\t    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486\t\n487\t    val_t kij = ZERO;\n488\t\n489\t    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490\t        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491\t        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492\t\n493\t        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494\t\n495\t        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n496\t        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n497\t        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n498\t\n499\t        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n500\t        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501\t\n502\t        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503\t\n504\t        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505\t    }\n506\t\n507\t    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n508\t}\n509\t\n510\t// ============================================================================\n511\t// Tau (time delay) Computation\n512\t// ============================================================================\n513\t\n514\tint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n515\t    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n516\t    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\t// ============================================================================\n520\t// Room Response Simulation State\n521\t// ============================================================================\n522\t\n523\tstruct SimulationState {\n524\t    size_t numTriangles;\n525\t    size_t numTimesteps;\n526\t\n527\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n528\t    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n529\t    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n530\t    std::vector<val_t> Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n537\t\n538\t    size_t sourceIndex;\n539\t\n540\t    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n541\t    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n542\t};\n543\t\n544\t// ============================================================================\n545\t// Initialization\n546\t// ============================================================================\n547\t\n548\tvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n549\t                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n550\t    // Generate mesh\n551\t    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n552\t    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n553\t    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n554\t    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n555\t    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n556\t\n557\t    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n558\t\n559\t    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n560\t    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n561\t    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n562\t\n563\t    // Initialize areas\n564\t    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n565\t    for (size_t i = 0; i ZERO);\n578\t\n579\t    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n580\t    size_t timeOn = 0;\n581\t    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n582\t    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n583\t        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n584\t    }\n585\t}\n586\t\n587\t// ============================================================================\n588\t// Precomputation Phase\n589\t// ============================================================================\n590\t\n591\tvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n592\t    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n593\t    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n594\t\n595\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n596\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n597\t || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n602\t            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n603\t        }\n604\t    }\n605\t}\n606\t\n607\tvoid Propagation)\n621\t// ============================================================================\n622\t\n623\tvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n624\t    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n625\t\n626\t    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n627\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n628\t            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n629\t\n630\t            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n631\t                if (i == j) continue;\n632\t\n633\t                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n634\t\n635\t                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n636\t                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n637\t\n638\t                val_t kij = state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n639\t                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n640\t\n641\t                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n642\t                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n643\t                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n644\t                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n645\t\n646\t                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n647\t                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n648\t            }\n649\t\n650\t            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n651\t            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n652\t        }\n653\t\n654\t        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n655\t            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n656\t        }\n657\t    }\n658\t}\n659\t\n660\t// ============================================================================\n661\t// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n662\t// ============================================================================\n663\t\n664\tvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n665\t    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n666\t\n667\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n668\t        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n669\t        int bestT = 0;\n670\t\n671\t        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n672\t        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n673\t            val_t sum = ZERO;\n674\t\n675\t            for (size_t tt = t; tt < state.numTimesteps; ++tt) {\n676\t                val_t pB = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, i)];\n677\t                val_t pS = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt - t, state.sourceIndex)];\n678\t                sum += pS * pB;\n679\t            }\n680\t\n681\t            if (sum > maxCorr) {\n682\t                maxCorr = sum;\n683\t                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n684\t            }\n685\t      }\n\n        // Otherwise, descend to children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n                if Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\nclass IcosphereMesh {\npublic:\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Random Number Generation\n// ============================================================================\n\nclass RandomGenerator {\n    std::mt19937 rng;\n    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\npublic:\n    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n};\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = ============================================================================\n\nval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t casting (shared host/device code)\n// ============================================================================\n\nHD inline bool rayIntersectsBoxFlat(const FlatNode& n, const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) {\n    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n    Vec3 c = p1 + d - n.center;\n    Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};\n\n    if (std::abs(c.x) > n.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n    if (std::abs(c.y) > n.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n    if (std::abs(c.z) > n.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n    if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > n.halfExtent.y * ad.z + n.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > n.halfExtent.z * ad.x + n.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > n.halfExtent.x * ad.y + n.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\nHD inline val_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                                     const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX_CONST;\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX_CONST;\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX_CONST;\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle.\n// Iterative octree traversal; the result is independent of the visiting order.\nHD inline bool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to, const FlatNode* nodes,\n                            const LeafTri* leaves, uint32_t srcTriIdx, uint32_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    int stack[64];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;\n    while(sp > 0) {\n        const FlatNode& n = nodes[stack[--sp]];\n        if(n.triCount > 0) {\n            for(int k = 0; k < n.triCount; ++k) {\n                const LeafTri lt = leaves[n.triStart + k];\n                if(lt.idx == srcTriIdx || lt.idx == dstTriIdx) continue;\n                val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, lt.a, lt.b, lt.c);\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) return true;\n            }\n        } else {\n            #pragma unroll\n            for(int i = 7; i >= 0; --i) {\n                int c = n.child[i];\n                if(c >= 0 && rayIntersectsBoxFlat(nodes[c], from, to)) stack[sp++] = c;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nHD inline val_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return fmaxf(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nHD inline Vec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, val_t u, val_t v) {\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// True if the pair is back-face culled, i.e. consumes no random numbers at all.\nHD inline bool pairCulled(const Vec3& nI, const Vec3& nJ) { return nI.dot(nJ) > 0.99f; }\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter).\n// 'rnd' holds the RND_PER_PAIR random values this pair would have drawn sequentially.\nHD inline val_t computeKij(uint32_t idxI, uint32_t idxJ, const Triangle* triangles,\n                           const FlatNode* nodes, const LeafTri* leaves, const float* rnd) {\n    const Triangle triI = triangles[idxI];\n    const Triangle triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (pairCulled(triI._normal, triJ._normal)) return ZERO;\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rnd[4 * r + 0], rnd[4 * r + 1]);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rnd[4 * r + 2], rnd[4 * r + 3]);\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, nodes, leaves, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI._normal);\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ._normal);\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\nclass IcosphereMesh {\npublic:\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            newFaces.reserve(faces.size() * 4);\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.resize(faces.size());\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (size_t f = 0; f < faces.size(); ++f) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles[f] = Triangle(vertices[faces[f][2]], vertices[faces[f][1]], vertices[faces[f][0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nHD inline int computeTau(const Vec3& centerI, const Vec3& centerJ) {\n    val_t dist = (centerI - centerJ).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// CUDA kernels\n// ============================================================================\n\n// One thread per triangle pair of a work tile.  A tile is a contiguous range of\n// 'tileCols' columns of one row; the random numbers of the tile are pre-generated on\n// the host at the exact offsets the sequential stream would have used.\n__global__ void kijKernel(int numTiles, int tileCols, uint32_t N, const uint32_t* __restrict__ tileRow,\n                          const uint32_t* __restrict__ tileCol, const Triangle* __restrict__ tris,\n                          const FlatNode* __restrict__ nodes, const LeafTri* __restrict__ leaves,\n                          const float* __restrict__ rnd, float* __restrict__ out) {\n    int gid = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if(gid >= numTiles * tileCols) return;\n    int tile = gid / tileCols;\n    int col = gid - tile * tileCols;\n    uint32_t i = tileRow[tile];\n    uint32_t j = tileCol[tile] + static_cast<uint32_t>(col);\n    if(j >= N) return;\n    if(i == j) {\n        out[gid] = ZERO;\n        return;\n    }\n    out[gid] = computeKij(i, j, tris, nodes, leaves, rnd + static_cast<size_t>(gid) * RND_PER_PAIR);\n}\n\n// Transpose a chunk of locally owned Kij rows into the column-major layout used by the\n// propagation kernel (so that consecutive threads read consecutive addresses).\n__global__ void transposeKij(const float* __restrict__ src, float* __restrict__ dst, int rows,\n                             uint32_t N, int nLocal, int rowOffset) {\n    __shared__ float tile[32][33];\n    uint32_t j0 = blockIdx.x * 32;\n    int r0 = blockIdx.y * 32;\n    uint32_t j = j0 + threadIdx.x;\n    for(int k = 0; k < 32; k += 8) {\n        int r = r0 + threadIdx.y + k;\n        if(r < rows && j < N) tile[threadIdx.y + k][threadIdx.x] = src[static_cast<size_t>(r) * N + j];\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n    int r = r0 + threadIdx.x;\n    for(int k = 0; k < 32; k += 8) {\n        uint32_t jj = j0 + threadIdx.y + k;\n        if(r < rows && jj < N)\n            dst[static_cast<size_t>(jj) * nLocal + rowOffset + r] = tile[threadIdx.x][threadIdx.y + k];\n    }\n}\n\n// Radiosity propagation for one timestep; one thread per locally owned triangle.\n// The summation order over j is identical to the sequential version.\n__global__ void simKernel(int nLocal, uint32_t N, int t, const uint32_t* __restrict__ myRows,\n                          const float* __restrict__ kijT, const Vec3* __restrict__ centers,\n                          const float* __restrict__ areas, const float* __restrict__ rho,\n                          const float* __restrict__ radB, const float* __restrict__ radE,\n                          float* __restrict__ outRow) {\n    int li = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if(li >= nLocal) return;\n    uint32_t i = myRows[li];\n    const Vec3 ci = centers[i];\n    val_t sumB = ZERO;\n    for(uint32_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n        if(i == j) continue;\n        val_t kij = kijT[static_cast<size_t>(j) * nLocal + li];\n        if(kij <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        int tauij = computeTau(ci, centers[j]);\n        // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n        if(t < tauij) continue;\n\n        val_t radJ = radB[static_cast<size_t>(t - tauij) * N + j];\n        if(radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        sumB += fminf(kij * areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n    }\n    outRow[li] = rho[i] * sumB + radE[static_cast<size_t>(t) * N + i];\n}\n\n// Cross-correlation: one block per locally owned triangle, threads split the lag range.\n__global__ void distKernel(uint32_t N, uint32_t T, const uint32_t* __restrict__ myRows,\n                           const float* __restrict__ radB, uint32_t srcIndex,\n                           float* __restrict__ distOut) {\n    extern __shared__ char smem[];\n    float* sVal = reinterpret_cast<float*>(smem);\n    int* sT = reinterpret_cast<int*>(sVal + blockDim.x);\n\n    int li = blockIdx.x;\n    uint32_t i = myRows[li];\n\n    val_t bestVal = ZERO;\n    int bestT = 0;\n    for(uint32_t t = threadIdx.x; t < T; t += blockDim.x) {\n        val_t sum = ZERO;\n        for(uint32_t tt = t; tt < T; ++tt) {\n            val_t pB = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt) * N + i];\n            val_t pS = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt - t) * N + srcIndex];\n            sum += pS * pB;\n        }\n        if(sum > bestVal) {\n            bestVal = sum;\n            bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n        }\n    }\n    sVal[threadIdx.x] = bestVal;\n    sT[threadIdx.x] = bestT;\n    __syncthreads();\n    // argmax reduction, ties resolved towards the smaller lag (as in the serial scan)\n    for(int s = blockDim.x / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n        if(static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) < s) {\n            float ov = sVal[threadIdx.x + s];\n            int ot = sT[threadIdx.x + s];\n            if(ov > sVal[threadIdx.x] || (ov == sVal[threadIdx.x] && ot < sT[threadIdx.x])) {\n                sVal[threadIdx.x] = ov;\n                sT[threadIdx.x] = ot;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    if(threadIdx.x == 0) distOut[li] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(sT[0]);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles = 0;\n    size_t numTimesteps = 0;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<Vec3> centers;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n    FlatOctree flat;                // Flattened octree for CPU workers / CUDA\n\n    // --- distributed data ---\n    std::vector<uint32_t> myRows;   // globally owned triangle rows of this rank\n    std::vector<val_t> kijLocal;    // form factors of the owned rows (nLocal x N)\n\n    size_t sourceIndex = 0;\n\n    // --- MPI / device context ---\n    int rank = 0, nranks = 1;\n    int device = 0;\n\n    // --- device buffers ---\n    Triangle* d_tris = nullptr;\n    FlatNode* d_nodes = nullptr;\n    LeafTri* d_leaves = nullptr;\n    Vec3* d_centers = nullptr;\n    float* d_areas = nullptr;\n    float* d_rho = nullptr;\n    float* d_radB = nullptr;\n    float* d_radE = nullptr;\n    float* d_kijT = nullptr;\n    uint32_t* d_myRows = nullptr;\n    float* d_rowOut = nullptr;\n    float* d_dist = nullptr;\n\n    size_t nLocal() const { return myRows.size(); }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Rows are handed out to the ranks in small cyclic blocks so that geometric cost\n// variations average out between the ranks.\nconstexpr int ROW_BLOCK = 4;\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    const bool root = state.rank == 0;\n\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    if(root) printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    if(root) printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n    flattenOctree(&state.octree, state.triangles, state.flat);\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n\n    // Initialize areas / centers\n    state.areas.resize(N);\n    state.centers.resize(N);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n        state.centers[i] = state.triangles[i].center();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.assign(N, reflectivity);\n\n    // Distribute the rows (cyclic blocks)\n    for(size_t b = 0; b < N; b += ROW_BLOCK) {\n        if(static_cast<int>((b / ROW_BLOCK) % static_cast<size_t>(state.nranks)) == state.rank) {\n            for(size_t i = b; i < std::min(b + ROW_BLOCK, N); ++i)\n                state.myRows.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(i));\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Initialize matrices\n    state.kijLocal.assign(state.nLocal() * N, ZERO);\n    state.radE.assign(timesteps * N, ZERO);\n    state.radB.assign(timesteps * N, ZERO);\n    state.distances.assign(N, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[t * N + state.sourceIndex] = 1.0f;\n    }\n\n    // ---- device setup ----\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(state.device));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_tris, N * sizeof(Triangle)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_tris, state.triangles.data(), N * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_nodes, state.flat.nodes.size() * sizeof(FlatNode)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_nodes, state.flat.nodes.data(),\n                          state.flat.nodes.size() * sizeof(FlatNode), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_leaves, std::max<size_t>(1, state.flat.leaves.size()) * sizeof(LeafTri)));\n    if(!state.flat.leaves.empty())\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_leaves, state.flat.leaves.data(),\n                              state.flat.leaves.size() * sizeof(LeafTri), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_centers, N * sizeof(Vec3)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_centers, state.centers.data(), N * sizeof(Vec3), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_areas, N * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_areas, state.areas.data(), N * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_rho, N * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_rho, state.rho.data(), N * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_radB, std::max<size_t>(1, timesteps * N) * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.d_radB, 0, std::max<size_t>(1, timesteps * N) * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_radE, std::max<size_t>(1, timesteps * N) * sizeof(float)));\n    if(timesteps * N > 0)\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_radE, state.radE.data(), timesteps * N * sizeof(float),\n                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_myRows, std::max<size_t>(1, state.nLocal()) * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n    if(state.nLocal() > 0)\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_myRows, state.myRows.data(), state.nLocal() * sizeof(uint32_t),\n                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_rowOut, std::max<size_t>(1, state.nLocal()) * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_dist, std::max<size_t>(1, state.nLocal()) * sizeof(float)));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase: form factors\n// ============================================================================\n//\n// Work is split into tiles of TILE_COLS columns of a single row.  CPU threads and the\n// GPU pull tiles from one shared atomic counter, so the CPU/GPU load balance adapts\n// itself to the machine at runtime.\n\nconstexpr int TILE_COLS = 256;\nconstexpr int GPU_TARGET_PAIRS = 1 << 17;  // pairs per kernel launch\n\nnamespace {\n\nstruct FormFactorContext {\n    SimulationState* st;\n    uint32_t N;\n    int tilesPerRow;\n    long long numTiles;\n    std::vector<MT19937> rowState;   // RNG state at the beginning of each owned row\n    std::atomic<long long> nextTile{0};\n};\n\n// Number of pairs in row i before column j that consume random numbers.\ninline uint32_t drawingPairsBefore(const SimulationState& st, uint32_t i, uint32_t j) {\n    const Vec3 nI = st.triangles[i]._normal;\n    uint32_t cnt = 0;\n    for(uint32_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n        if(k == i) continue;\n        if(!pairCulled(nI, st.triangles[k]._normal)) ++cnt;\n    }\n    return cnt;\n}\n\n// Seed an engine for the tile (row 'localRow', first column 'j0').\ninline MT19937 engineForTile(FormFactorContext& ctx, int localRow, uint32_t j0) {\n    MT19937 eng = ctx.rowState[localRow];\n    if(j0 > 0)\n        eng.advance(static_cast<uint64_t>(RND_PER_PAIR) *\n                    drawingPairsBefore(*ctx.st, ctx.st->myRows[localRow], j0));\n    return eng;\n}\n\n}  // namespace\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    const bool root = state.rank == 0;\n    if(root) printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n\n    const uint32_t N = static_cast<uint32_t>(state.numTriangles);\n    const int nLocal = static_cast<int>(state.nLocal());\n\n    FormFactorContext ctx;\n    ctx.st = &state;\n    ctx.N = N;\n    ctx.tilesPerRow = static_cast<int>((N + TILE_COLS - 1) / TILE_COLS);\n    ctx.numTiles = static_cast<long long>(nLocal) * ctx.tilesPerRow;\n\n    // ---- random stream bookkeeping -----------------------------------------\n    // Number of random draws consumed by every row of the global matrix.\n    std::vector<uint64_t> rowDraws(N, 0);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for(uint32_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        const Vec3 nI = state.triangles[i]._normal;\n        uint32_t cnt = 0;\n        for(uint32_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            if(i == j) continue;\n            if(!pairCulled(nI, state.triangles[j]._normal)) ++cnt;\n        }\n        rowDraws[i] = static_cast<uint64_t>(cnt) * RND_PER_PAIR;\n    }\n\n    // RNG state at the start of each owned row (rows are in increasing order).\n    ctx.rowState.resize(nLocal);\n    {\n        MT19937 eng;\n        eng.seed(42);\n        uint64_t pos = 0;\n        uint64_t prefix = 0;\n        uint32_t nextRow = 0;\n        for(int li = 0; li < nLocal; ++li) {\n            uint32_t row = state.myRows[li];\n            for(; nextRow < row; ++nextRow) prefix += rowDraws[nextRow];\n            eng.advance(prefix - pos);\n            pos = prefix;\n            ctx.rowState[li] = eng;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---- hybrid CPU/GPU tile processing ------------------------------------\n    const int maxTilesPerBatch = std::max(1, GPU_TARGET_PAIRS / TILE_COLS);\n    const size_t rndPerBatch = static_cast<size_t>(maxTilesPerBatch) * TILE_COLS * RND_PER_PAIR;\n    const size_t outPerBatch = static_cast<size_t>(maxTilesPerBatch) * TILE_COLS;\n\n    int nThreads = omp_get_max_threads();\n    if(nThreads < 2) nThreads = 2;\n    const int fillThreads = std::max(1, std::min(8, nThreads / 4));\n\n    std::atomic<long long> tilesDone{0};\n\n    #pragma omp parallel num_threads(nThreads)\n    {\n        const int tid = omp_get_thread_num();\n        if(tid == 0) {\n            // ---------------- GPU driver ----------------\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(state.device));\n            constexpr int NBUF = 2;\n            cudaStream_t stream[NBUF];\n            cudaEvent_t done[NBUF];\n            float* h_rnd[NBUF];\n            float* h_out[NBUF];\n            float* d_rnd[NBUF];\n            float* d_out[NBUF];\n            uint32_t* h_row[NBUF];\n            uint32_t* h_col[NBUF];\n            uint32_t* d_row[NBUF];\n            uint32_t* d_col[NBUF];\n            std::vector<int> batchLocalRow[NBUF];\n            std::vector<uint32_t> batchCol[NBUF];\n            bool inFlight[NBUF] = {false, false};\n\n            for(int b = 0; b < NBUF; ++b) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreate(&stream[b]));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&done[b], cudaEventDisableTiming));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&h_rnd[b], rndPerBatch * sizeof(float)));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&h_out[b], outPerBatch * sizeof(float)));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&h_row[b], maxTilesPerBatch * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&h_col[b], maxTilesPerBatch * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_rnd[b], rndPerBatch * sizeof(float)));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_out[b], outPerBatch * sizeof(float)));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_row[b], maxTilesPerBatch * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_col[b], maxTilesPerBatch * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n            }\n\n            auto drain = [&](int b) {\n                if(!inFlight[b]) return;\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(done[b]));\n                const int nt = static_cast<int>(batchLocalRow[b].size());\n                for(int t = 0; t < nt; ++t) {\n                    const int li = batchLocalRow[b][t];\n                    const uint32_t j0 = batchCol[b][t];\n                    const uint32_t len = std::min<uint32_t>(TILE_COLS, N - j0);\n                    std::memcpy(&state.kijLocal[static_cast<size_t>(li) * N + j0],\n                                h_out[b] + static_cast<size_t>(t) * TILE_COLS, len * sizeof(float));\n                }\n                tilesDone.fetch_add(nt, std::memory_order_relaxed);\n                inFlight[b] = false;\n            };\n\n            int cur = 0;\n            while(true) {\n                long long remaining = ctx.numTiles - ctx.nextTile.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);\n                if(remaining <= 0) break;\n                // Do not swallow the tail: leave work for the CPU threads near the end.\n                int want = static_cast<int>(std::min<long long>(maxTilesPerBatch, remaining));\n                long long start = ctx.nextTile.fetch_add(want, std::memory_order_relaxed);\n                if(start >= ctx.numTiles) break;\n                int nt = static_cast<int>(std::min<long long>(want, ctx.numTiles - start));\n                if(nt <= 0) break;\n\n                drain(cur);\n\n                batchLocalRow[cur].resize(nt);\n                batchCol[cur].resize(nt);\n                for(int t = 0; t < nt; ++t) {\n                    long long tile = start + t;\n                    int li = static_cast<int>(tile / ctx.tilesPerRow);\n                    uint32_t j0 = static_cast<uint32_t>((tile % ctx.tilesPerRow) * TILE_COLS);\n                    batchLocalRow[cur][t] = li;\n                    batchCol[cur][t] = j0;\n                    h_row[cur][t] = state.myRows[li];\n                    h_col[cur][t] = j0;\n                }\n\n                // Generate the random numbers for the batch (parallel over tiles).\n                #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1) num_threads(fillThreads)\n                for(int t = 0; t < nt; ++t) {\n                    const int li = batchLocalRow[cur][t];\n                    const uint32_t i = state.myRows[li];\n                    const uint32_t j0 = batchCol[cur][t];\n                    const uint32_t len = std::min<uint32_t>(TILE_COLS, N - j0);\n                    MT19937 eng = engineForTile(ctx, li, j0);\n                    float* base = h_rnd[cur] + static_cast<size_t>(t) * TILE_COLS * RND_PER_PAIR;\n                    const Vec3 nI = state.triangles[i]._normal;\n                    for(uint32_t c = 0; c < len; ++c) {\n                        uint32_t j = j0 + c;\n                        if(j == i || pairCulled(nI, state.triangles[j]._normal)) continue;\n                        eng.genFloats(base + static_cast<size_t>(c) * RND_PER_PAIR, RND_PER_PAIR);\n                    }\n                }\n\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(d_row[cur], h_row[cur], nt * sizeof(uint32_t),\n                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream[cur]));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(d_col[cur], h_col[cur], nt * sizeof(uint32_t),\n                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream[cur]));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(d_rnd[cur], h_rnd[cur],\n                                           static_cast<size_t>(nt) * TILE_COLS * RND_PER_PAIR * sizeof(float),\n                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream[cur]));\n                const int threads = 128;\n                const int blocks = (nt * TILE_COLS + threads - 1) / threads;\n                kijKernel<<<blocks, threads, 0, stream[cur]>>>(nt, TILE_COLS, N, d_row[cur], d_col[cur],\n                                                               state.d_tris, state.d_nodes,\n                                                               state.d_leaves, d_rnd[cur], d_out[cur]);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(h_out[cur], d_out[cur],\n                                           static_cast<size_t>(nt) * TILE_COLS * sizeof(float),\n                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream[cur]));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(done[cur], stream[cur]));\n                inFlight[cur] = true;\n                cur = (cur + 1) % NBUF;\n            }\n            for(int b = 0; b < NBUF; ++b) drain(b);\n            for(int b = 0; b < NBUF; ++b) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream[b]));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(done[b]));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(h_rnd[b]));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(h_out[b]));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(h_row[b]));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(h_col[b]));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_rnd[b]));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_out[b]));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_row[b]));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_col[b]));\n            }\n        } else {\n            // ---------------- CPU workers ----------------\n            float rnd[RND_PER_PAIR];\n            while(true) {\n                long long tile = ctx.nextTile.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);\n                if(tile >= ctx.numTiles) break;\n                const int li = static_cast<int>(tile / ctx.tilesPerRow);\n                const uint32_t i = state.myRows[li];\n                const uint32_t j0 = static_cast<uint32_t>((tile % ctx.tilesPerRow) * TILE_COLS);\n                const uint32_t len = std::min<uint32_t>(TILE_COLS, N - j0);\n                MT19937 eng = engineForTile(ctx, li, j0);\n                const Vec3 nI = state.triangles[i]._normal;\n                float* dst = &state.kijLocal[static_cast<size_t>(li) * N + j0];\n                for(uint32_t c = 0; c < len; ++c) {\n                    const uint32_t j = j0 + c;\n                    if(j == i) {\n                        dst[c] = ZERO;\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                    if(pairCulled(nI, state.triangles[j]._normal)) {\n                        dst[c] = ZERO;\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                    eng.genFloats(rnd, RND_PER_PAIR);\n                    dst[c] = computeKij(i, j, state.triangles.data(), state.flat.nodes.data(),\n                                        state.flat.leaves.data(), rnd);\n                }\n                tilesDone.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Upload the form factors in the transposed layout needed by the propagation kernel.\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(state.device));\n    if(nLocal > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_kijT, static_cast<size_t>(nLocal) * N * sizeof(float)));\n        const int chunkRows = std::max(1, static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(nLocal, (64u << 20) / (N * sizeof(float) + 1))));\n        float* d_tmp = nullptr;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_tmp, static_cast<size_t>(chunkRows) * N * sizeof(float)));\n        for(int r0 = 0; r0 < nLocal; r0 += chunkRows) {\n            int rows = std::min(chunkRows, nLocal - r0);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_tmp, &state.kijLocal[static_cast<size_t>(r0) * N],\n                                  static_cast<size_t>(rows) * N * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            dim3 block(32, 8);\n            dim3 grid((N + 31) / 32, (rows + 31) / 32);\n            transposeKij<<<grid, block>>>(d_tmp, state.d_kijT, rows, N, nLocal, r0);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_tmp));\n    }\n\n    // Progress reporting: the rows are processed out of order and in parallel, so the\n    // original per-row progress lines are emitted once the phase is complete.\n    if(root) {\n        for(size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n            if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n                printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    // The time delays are a pure function of the triangle centers and are evaluated\n    // directly inside the propagation kernel; materializing the full N x N matrix would\n    // only add O(N^2) memory traffic.\n    if(state.rank == 0) printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    const bool root = state.rank == 0;\n    if(root) printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    const uint32_t N = static_cast<uint32_t>(state.numTriangles);\n    const int nLocal = static_cast<int>(state.nLocal());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(state.device));\n\n    std::vector<float> hostLocal(std::max(1, nLocal));\n    std::vector<float> fullRow(N);\n\n    const int threads = 128;\n    const int blocks = (nLocal + threads - 1) / threads;\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        if(nLocal > 0) {\n            simKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(nLocal, N, static_cast<int>(t), state.d_myRows,\n                                           state.d_kijT, state.d_centers, state.d_areas, state.d_rho,\n                                           state.d_radB, state.d_radE, state.d_rowOut);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostLocal.data(), state.d_rowOut, nLocal * sizeof(float),\n                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        }\n\n        std::fill(fullRow.begin(), fullRow.end(), ZERO);\n        for(int li = 0; li < nLocal; ++li) fullRow[state.myRows[li]] = hostLocal[li];\n        if(state.nranks > 1)\n            MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, fullRow.data(), static_cast<int>(N), MPI_FLOAT, MPI_SUM,\n                          MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        std::memcpy(&state.radB[t * N], fullRow.data(), N * sizeof(float));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_radB + static_cast<size_t>(t) * N, fullRow.data(),\n                              N * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        if(root && ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps)) {\n            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    if(state.rank == 0) printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    const uint32_t N = static_cast<uint32_t>(state.numTriangles);\n    const int nLocal = static_cast<int>(state.nLocal());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(state.device));\n\n    std::vector<float> hostLocal(std::max(1, nLocal), ZERO);\n    if(nLocal > 0 && state.numTimesteps > 0) {\n        const int threads = 128;\n        const size_t shmem = threads * (sizeof(float) + sizeof(int));\n        distKernel<<<nLocal, threads, shmem>>>(N, static_cast<uint32_t>(state.numTimesteps),\n                                               state.d_myRows, state.d_radB,\n                                               static_cast<uint32_t>(state.sourceIndex), state.d_dist);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostLocal.data(), state.d_dist, nLocal * sizeof(float),\n                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    }\n\n    std::fill(state.distances.begin(), state.distances.end(), ZERO);\n    for(int li = 0; li < nLocal; ++li) state.distances[state.myRows[li]] = hostLocal[li];\n    if(state.nranks > 1)\n        MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, state.distances.data(), static_cast<int>(N), MPI_FLOAT, MPI_SUM,\n                      MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n    // Kij is distributed, so its statistics need a global reduction first.\n    long long localNonZeroKij = 0;\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(+ : localNonZeroKij)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.kijLocal.size(); ++i) {\n        if (state.kijLocal[i] > EPSILON) localNonZeroKij++;\n    }\n    long long nonZeroKijGlobal = localNonZeroKij;\n    if(state.nranks > 1)\n        MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &nonZeroKijGlobal, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG, MPI_SUM, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if(state.rank != 0) return true;\n\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            if (state.radB[t * state.numTriangles + i] > EPSILON) {\n                receivedEnergy++;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n    const size_t totalKij = state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles;\n    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %lld/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n           nonZeroKijGlobal, totalKij,\n           100.0f * static_cast<val_t>(nonZeroKijGlobal) / static_cast<val_t>(totalKij));\n\n    if (nonZeroKijGlobal == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!allNonNegative) {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Hash for Verification\n// ============================================================================\n\nuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);\n        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count\n// ============================================================================\n\nint getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {\n    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision\n    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480\n    int subdivisions = 0;\n    int triangles = 20;\n    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {\n        subdivisions++;\n        triangles *= 4;\n    }\n    return subdivisions;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Main\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\\n\");\n    printf(\"               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\\n\");\n    printf(\"               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -o           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int provided = 0;\n    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n\n    int rank = 0, nranks = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nranks);\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    int targetTriangles = 320;\n    int timesteps = 50;\n    int sourceIdx = 0;\n    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            targetTriangles = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            timesteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sourceIdx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            reflectivity = static_cast<val_t>(atof(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-o\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if(root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if(root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---- MPI/GPU/OpenMP topology ----\n    MPI_Comm nodeComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &nodeComm);\n    int localRank = 0, localSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(nodeComm, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(nodeComm, &localSize);\n\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    if(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount) != cudaSuccess || deviceCount == 0) {\n        if(root) fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA device available\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    const int device = localRank % deviceCount;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));  // establish the context up front\n\n    if(getenv(\"OMP_NUM_THREADS\") == nullptr) {\n        int hw = omp_get_num_procs();\n        omp_set_num_threads(std::max(1, hw / std::max(1, localSize)));\n    }\n    omp_set_max_active_levels(2);\n\n    int subdivisions = getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(targetTriangles);\n\n    if(root) {\n        printf(\"Room Response Simulation Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"===================================\\n\");\n        printf(\"Target triangles: %d (using %d subdivisions)\\n\", targetTriangles, subdivisions);\n        printf(\"Timesteps: %d\\n\", timesteps);\n        printf(\"Source triangle: %d\\n\", sourceIdx);\n        printf(\"Reflectivity: %.2f\\n\", reflectivity);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d, OpenMP threads/rank: %d, GPUs/node: %d\\n\", nranks,\n               omp_get_max_threads(), deviceCount);\n        printf(\"\\n\");\n    }\n\n    // Initialize\n    SimulationState state;\n    state.rank = rank;\n    state.nranks = nranks;\n    state.device = device;\n    initializeSimulation(state, subdivisions, static_cast<size_t>(timesteps),\n                         static_cast<size_t>(sourceIdx), reflectivity);\n\n    if(root) printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Precomputation\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto startPre = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    computeTimeDelays(state);\n    computeFormFactors(state);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto endPre = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto preDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endPre - startPre).count();\n\n    if(root) {\n        printf(\"Precomputation time: %ld ms\\n\", preDuration);\n        printf(\"\\n\");\n    }\n\n    // Simulation\n    auto startSim = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    runSimulation(state);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto endSim = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto simDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endSim - startSim).count();\n\n    if(root) {\n        printf(\"Simulation time: %ld ms\\n\", simDuration);\n        printf(\"\\n\");\n    }\n\n    // Distance computation\n    auto startDist = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    computeDistances(state);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto endDist = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto distDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endDist -
